entries.test: Whether hallucinations keep showing up across all major LLMs despite fixes and scaling, as shown by published hallucination benchmarks and technical analyses of why LLMs hallucinate.
entries.note: The proposition leaves out the normative second half of the sentence (the call for new approaches), which is a separate value judgment. 'Core to how LLMs work' is loosely worded, but the plain reading is that hallucination is built into the architecture and not a fixable bug.
